note: Provenance and redistribution record for every file under gui/assets/ (this manifest excepted). The GUI shows a bundled image only when its entry here has a redistributable license; tests/unit/test_asset_manifest.py fails when a file is added, replaced or removed without updating this record. Images carry a SHA-256 so replaced artwork cannot inherit an old license entry; the JSON data files are edited by hand and are not hashed.
